tiers.pro-flagship: paid/agency tier - Opus, Pro, -pro variants, Kimi K3
tiers.standard: default paid tier - Sonnet, gpt-5.6 terra/sol, Grok, DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Mistral

prompt_bank.note: Identical task list across every model within a pass, so styles compare like-for-like.

honest_notes: No model refused a task outright. 34 of 4,050 samples (0.8%) were quarantined: 24 with finish_reason 'error' (21 of them z-ai/glm-5.3, which produced degenerate token salad on a handful of high-temperature runs), 9 with finish_reason 'content_filter' (all anthropic/claude-fable-5, cut mid-piece rather than refused), and 1 mistral-medium-3-5 news piece that degenerated into multilingual noise at temperature 1.2.
28 samples hit the max_tokens ceiling (finish_reason 'length'). They are 776-2160 words of coherent prose that stop mid-sentence. Kept and flagged, not quarantined.

OpenRouter ':batch' model ids are NOT reachable through /chat/completions - they return 404 pointing at /api/beta/batches. The half-price saving was therefore not available and every sample was generated at synchronous pricing. Recorded because the owner asked for batch endpoints to be used.
google/gemini-* endpoints reject reasoning:{enabled:false}; those models were run with reasoning effort 'low' instead, so their completion token counts (and cost) include reasoning tokens.
Google has no current Pro-tier Gemini above 3.1 on OpenRouter - gemini-3.1-pro-preview (2026-02-19) is the newest Pro id available. The 3.5/3.6/3.7 line is Flash only.
Meta's newest instruct model on OpenRouter is still llama-4-maverick (2025-04-05). There is no Llama 4.x refresh to sample, so the Meta slice is not a 2026 model.
Word counts vary by register on purpose: social posts target 60-350 words, articles and academic pieces 600-1200. Mean 772 words, median 844.
Every sample is a finished published-style piece. No chat replies, no 'Sure, here's' framing - the PREAMBLE stripper fired on zero samples, so the system prompt held.

outputs.generated.jsonl: combined corpus, one row per sample, eval-set.jsonl shape plus prompt_id, prompt_style, temperature, generated_at, usage, tier, register, length_band
